name: Kesh
description: Kesh was a planet located in the Kesh system in Wild Space, in grid square U-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid, past the eastern edge of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Keshiri species, and the planet never joined the Galactic Republic.
